nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can machine learning be utilized for integrated scheduling and rescheduling for elective and emergency patients in the operating theatre, as discussed by Ashfall et al. (2023)?
nodes.answer: Machine learning can be used for integrated scheduling and rescheduling for elective and emergency patients in the operating theatre by optimizing the allocation of resources and minimizing waiting times for patients.
